basis.unique_subjects: Only five conservative public source/subject groups have sparse references; no sealed unseen target-domain subject test exists.
basis.event_region_coverage: A few standing, raised-arm, leaning and seated views; no adequate lying/prone, strong twist, robot/bed/contact, body-shape, clothing and occlusion strata.
basis.supervision_independence: Existing contour drafts were produced after predictions had been viewed, and S05 mask/contour share the same image. SAM/MHR fits and Atlas projections are model-derived.
basis.target_back_relevance: Twenty-five references are sparse 2D outer-boundary samples, not a dense visible bare-back surface or calibrated depth measurement.

why_no_10_epoch_surface_run: Without an independent held-out surface metric, a lower training contour loss would only demonstrate fitting and could not answer whether unseen back surfaces improve.

minimum_collection_plan.scope: Operational minimum for a controlled pilot, not a powered clinical study
minimum_collection_plan.images: 2-4 non-adjacent target-region observations per subject (about 60-120 images)
minimum_collection_plan.split_rule: Split by verified person plus capture session before annotation/model review; no adjacent frames or same person across splits.
required_event_families: prone/lying on treatment bed with and without robot/contact occlusion
standing with neutral, raised-arm and strong-twist poses

annotation.source_view: Annotate original RGB/depth without any mesh overlay.
annotation.geometry: Dense pixel mask plus uncertainty boundary; calibrated depth or multi-view surface where available.
annotation.quality: Two independent annotators for validation/test, adjudication, and saved disagreement/unknown regions.
annotation.provenance: Record subject/session IDs, camera calibration, timestamps, annotator, revision, and whether any prediction had been seen.

use.train: 18-subject labels may drive the new surface loss.
use.validation: 6 subjects may select epoch and loss weight; they cease to be final test once used for tuning.
use.sealed_test: 6 subjects remain inaccessible until protocol, code, thresholds and checkpoint are frozen.

minimum_collection_plan.primary_metric: Held-out visible bare-back symmetric contour distance and, where depth exists, robust point-to-observed-depth error; report mean/median/P90/P95/worst/per-subject.
